info.title: AutoBuy Crypto API
info.description:
Automated cryptocurrency purchasing platform: schedule recurring USDT buys (daily/weekly/biweekly/monthly), executed on Binance with KYC gating, encrypted key storage, and full transaction history.

All protected endpoints expect `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. Validation failures return **422**; rate limits return **429** with `Retry-After`. Full guides: `docs/API.md`, `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`.

get.description: Health check endpoint for monitoring.

post.description: Register a new user with email and password.
Authenticate with email/password and receive access + refresh tokens.
Verify an access token; returns validity and the user id it belongs to.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair.
Revoke a refresh token. The short-lived access token simply expires.
Change the password and invalidate every token issued before now.

verify deliveries via X-AutoBuy-Signature (hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body).

post.description: Make a schedule due immediately (next scheduler tick executes it).

get.description: Live evaluation of the docs/ALERTING.md conditions the app can see.

schema.title: Response Alerts Api Admin Alerts Get

post.description: Emergency stop: no purchases execute until resumed (or restart).
Restart the paused scheduler.

One-shot buy that executes only once the price is at or below
`limit_price`; checked hourly, expires unexecuted after `expiry_days`.

Split a per-period budget across target allocations as a set of
rebalancing schedules. Per-coin slices below the 10 USDT venue minimum
are rejected outright rather than silently dropped.

get.description:
Buy-only rebalancing drift analysis: compares current market-value
weights to the active plan's targets and suggests skewing the next
period's budget toward underweights. Never suggests selling.
Unrealized P&L per holding against live prices, with best/worst performers.

Average buy price vs the market now, plus a diversification score
(100 × (1 − Herfindahl index) over invested value).
Spend projections from the enabled schedules.

30-day daily-return volatility per held/scheduled coin, with a DCA-cadence
suggestion: higher volatility rewards smaller, more frequent buys.

post.description: Create (or reuse) the Sumsub applicant and return a WebSDK token.

get.description: Sync and return the caller's KYC status from Sumsub.

post.description:
Sumsub review-result callback. HMAC-verified; updates kyc_status and
notifies the user by email.

Create the caller's Sumsub applicant (legal name + account email) and
remember its id. Idempotent: an account that already has an applicant gets
the existing id back. The email must match the account — KYC identity is
bound to the login, never to an arbitrary address.

get.description:
Live review state for an applicant. Users may only query their own
applicant (admins: any); the caller's kyc_status is synced on the way.

post.description:
Sumsub applicant webhook (applicantReviewed, applicantPending, ...).

The raw body is verified against ``x-payload-digest`` using the algorithm
in ``x-payload-digest-alg`` (default HMAC_SHA256_HEX) before anything is
parsed; every event is logged; review results update the user's
kyc_status through the same path as ``POST /api/kyc/webhook``.
Accept Resend delivery events (bounce/complaint). Stub: log only.

Email the caller a 24-hour verification link for their account address.
The address must be the one on the account.

Send a plain notification email. Users may only notify their own
address; admins may notify any address. The message is sent as text and
HTML-escaped, never rendered as markup.

get.description: All of the caller's Auto-Buy purchases, each with its latest transaction.

schema.title: Response List Purchases Api V2 Purchases Get

post.description:
Create a purchase in one of two modes: `withdraw_immediately: true`
(Auto-Buy: buy, then send the coins to `wallet_address`; wallet required)
or `false` (DCA accumulate: buy and hold on the exchange; wallet optional).
Rejects (422 with `{error, details}`) when a given wallet address does not
match the coin's chain or the declared network, when the exchange account
cannot withdraw to that network (immediate mode), or when the exchange
account is not the caller's.

get.description: One purchase with its full transaction history (newest first).

put.description:
Pause (`status: paused`), resume (`status: active`) or change amount/frequency.
Cancelled, completed and failed purchases cannot be changed.

delete.description:
Cancel a purchase. The record and its transaction history are kept;
the scheduler will never execute it again.

get.description:
Transaction history for a purchase, optionally filtered by status
(pending / success / failed).

schema.title: Response Purchase Transactions Api V2 Purchases  Purchase Id  Transactions Get

post.description:
Save a wallet. The address must be a valid Bitcoin, Ethereum or Solana
address usable on the declared network; addresses are unique platform-wide.

get.description: The caller's wallets, newest first; filter with `?blockchain_network=mainnet|testnet`.

schema.title: Response List Wallets Api Wallets Get

delete.description: Remove a saved wallet. Existing purchases keep their address.
